comparison.objective: Close an edge joint between two boards using a ratcheting one-hand bar clamp and leave at least 20 N clamping force.
comparison.physical_skill: Positioning clamp jaws, pumping a sprung trigger through a one-way drive and force-controlled closure; candidate uses two-tab grasping and loose-body agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Jaws and joint within 0.5 mm, force ≥20 N, boards aligned/level, hands clear and assembly still for 1 s. Earlier versions clamp stacked boards, but none grade separation. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: Both require controlled force and released stability, but ratchet actuation and maintained clamping force test a different mechanism and outcome from selective screening.
